current.name: Providers and API synchronization core
current.validation_rule: Lot 5.2 is maintainer validated. Sub-lot 5.3 audit corrections are implemented and await maintainer re-audit. No sub-lot 5.4 work is authorized.

lot_5_3_approved_concepts.real_adapters: OCBlackTop and TheSportsDB real adapters are used for connection testing and championship discovery only
lot_5_3_approved_concepts.no_event_sync: No provider event synchronization, bootstrap or historical event import in 5.3
lot_5_3_approved_concepts.wrc: WRC remains an OCBlackTop championship; provider/championship source config selects the appropriate strategy
lot_5_3_approved_concepts.unassociated_discoveries: Provider discoveries are persisted separately before any local championship association
lot_5_3_approved_concepts.manual_validation: A discovered championship never creates a local business championship automatically
lot_5_3_approved_concepts.alternative_sources: Multiple provider sources may be associated with one local championship but only one principal source is active in V1
lot_5_3_approved_concepts.proposed_source_config: Rediscovery stores proposed config separately and never overwrites approved config automatically
lot_5_3_approved_concepts.adopt_action: Adopt discovered configuration is an explicit audited operation that never triggers synchronization
lot_5_3_approved_concepts.periodic_discovery: Configurable per provider, 30 days default, 7 days minimum, can be disabled
lot_5_3_approved_concepts.periodic_execution: 5.3 implements eligibility/model; actual persistent periodic scheduling is wired in 5.4
lot_5_3_approved_concepts.quota_guard: Discovery counts requests and applies conservative safe-limit guards without implementing the full 5.5 quota engine
lot_5_3_approved_concepts.current_reserve: Discovery must not intentionally consume the 30 percent current-year reserve
lot_5_3_approved_concepts.not_found: Three complete consecutive discovery absences mark a provider championship as not found; failures/partial runs do not count
lot_5_3_approved_concepts.history: Minimal durable DISCOVERY history records origin, timing, status, request usage and result counters

next_action.task: Audit and validate sub-lot 5.3. Do not authorize or begin Lot 5.4 implicitly.
